findings.text: _evidence_figure_rule classifies on FIGURE_NAME_PATTERN (figure, plot, chart, graph, diagram) while the clauses it compiles assert the done-when 'states a measure'; a done-when such as 'the gate cuts runtime by 30 percent' composes 'Your done-when states no measure, so this node has no figure to draw' (reproduced by composing at e0c9d608). The withholding this section exists to remove survives for the common quantitative done-when, and the clause states a falsehood about the node.

The manifest template is emitted under 'write exactly these keys' and carries no 'figures:' line, while the rule composed at line 244 tells the worker to name the figure on the manifest's 'figures:' line; reckon/crew/reports.py:2156 already reads that key, so the template, in this node's own declared write path, should gain it.

The drawable assertion compares the composed prompt against the same module constant the producer inserts (EVIDENCE_FIGURE_ANNOUNCED), and the fixture at line 37 encodes 'states a measure' as containing the word 'figure', so a regression that narrows FIGURE_NAME_PATTERN would leave every case green; the assertion is not independent of the classification under test.
For the brief carrier figure_src is 'src /<project>/figures/' and the composed sentence reads 'with the project-absolute src /<project>/figures/;', a truncated source that names no leaf path.
